# REST API reference

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_api_ref.py from the backend's OpenAPI schema. Do not edit by hand: change the code and run `python tools/gen_api_ref.py`. -->

> **Generated.** This page is produced by `tools/gen_api_ref.py` from the FastAPI app in `backend/main.py`. Edit the route, not this page. `python tools/gen_api_ref.py --check` fails when the page is out of date.

The default install serves **92 routes** (method and path pairs). The app publishes no OpenAPI document, Swagger UI or ReDoc page: those endpoints are switched off, and this page is built from the schema in-process instead.

## How access works

One gate, an ASGI middleware in `backend/auth.py`, sits in front of every route, including paths that do not exist. It decides before any handler runs:

- **Public routes** answer a caller with no credential. Every other route needs a signed-in browser session (cookie) or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. A caller with neither gets 401 JSON, or a redirect to the login page if it is a browser asking for HTML.
- **Never both.** A request carrying both a session cookie and a Bearer header is refused with 400.
- **Writes.** A session caller must send the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin. A token caller is checked against the scope the route needs (`write` or `admin`); a write route with no scope mapped refuses tokens.
- **Forced password change.** An account that must change its password reaches only the sign-in pages, the privacy page and the health probes until it does: `/auth/denied`, `/auth/login`, `/auth/logout`, `/auth/password/change`, `/auth/privacy`, `/favicon.ico`, `/healthz`, `/readyz`.
- **Host allow-list.** A request for a host the install does not answer for is refused with 421 on every path.

The **Auth** line on each route states what the gate asks. A handler can refuse more: many routes check node visibility, and some are owner-only or refuse every token. The route description says so where it applies.

Validation errors are 422 with an `HTTPValidationError` body. The response types are the ones FastAPI declares, which is JSON by default: routes that answer with an HTML page, a file or a redirect (the board, the sign-in pages, `/assets`, `/docs`) still show JSON here. The routes in the `legacy_v0` group answer 404 when `ATLAS_LEGACY_V0=0`; they stay registered, so they are listed.

## Routes

Grouped by the module that declares them: `backend/routers/<group>.py`, or `auth` for the sign-in routes the gate itself adds.

### `access`

#### `GET /api/access`

**Get Access.** The whole access matrix in one read — accounts down, nodes across.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `PUT /api/access/github/{user_id}`

**Put Github Access.** Approve (invite) or revoke (remove / cancel) one account's repo access. OWNER-ONLY + session CSRF + `admin` scope - the same mechanism as `PUT /api/access/node/{id}`, so no token of any scope can reach it.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. Write: a token needs the `admin` scope; a session needs the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (application/json, required): [GithubAccessWrite](#githubaccesswrite)

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

#### `POST /api/access/github/{user_id}/refresh`

**Refresh Github Access.** Re-read from GitHub whether an invitation was accepted (or withdrawn). Owner-only, same mechanism as the PUT; it changes only Atlas's cached view.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. Write: a token needs the `admin` scope; a session needs the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (application/json, required): [CsrfOnly](#csrfonly)

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

#### `GET /api/access/groups`

**List Groups.** Every group with its members (owner-only). Reads no node data.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `POST /api/access/groups`

**Create Group.** Create a LOCAL group. 400 naming `name` if it is blank or too long, 409 if a group of that name exists.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. Write: a token needs the `admin` scope; a session needs the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin.

**Request body** (application/json, required): [GroupCreate](#groupcreate)

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

#### `DELETE /api/access/groups/{group_id}`

**Delete Group.** Delete a group, every membership in it and every binding naming it.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. Write: a token needs the `admin` scope; a session needs the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin.

### `adrs`

#### `GET /api/adrs`

**List Adrs.** Filter by project, status, legacy `number`, and `q` (an id, a legacy number, or words in the title and body). Ordered by project, then the project's own sequence.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

#### `PUT /api/adrs/{adr_id}`

**Put Adr.** Upsert one ADR, or allocate one with `adr_id` = `new`. A write that changes nothing writes nothing, not even an event, so a nightly sync over unchanged files leaves no trace. Refusals are 400s naming the field.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. Write: a token needs the `write` scope; a session needs the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adr_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (application/json, required): [AdrWrite](#adrwrite)

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

#### `GET /api/adrs/{ref}`

**Get Adr.**

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |

### `assets`

#### `GET /`

**Root.** The bare domain (ADR 0035, 2026-08-25). `/` is in `auth.PUBLIC_ROUTES`, so the gate never refuses it — but it is NOT a fixed response: this handler reads `auth.current_principal`, which the gate still sets on a public route whenever a credential WAS presented, and branches on it.

**Auth:** Public: the gate admits a caller with no credential. A credential that is presented and invalid is still refused with 401.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `HEAD /`

**Root.** The bare domain (ADR 0035, 2026-08-25). `/` is in `auth.PUBLIC_ROUTES`, so the gate never refuses it — but it is NOT a fixed response: this handler reads `auth.current_principal`, which the gate still sets on a public route whenever a credential WAS presented, and branches on it.

**Auth:** Public: the gate admits a caller with no credential. A credential that is presented and invalid is still refused with 401.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `GET /assets/{name:path}`

Not in the OpenAPI schema (`include_in_schema=False`).

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

#### `GET /board`

**Board.** The board: board v2 (ADR 0043) since the cutover on 2026-10-22. Authenticated like everything else — `/board` is NOT in `auth.PUBLIC_ROUTES`, only `/` is (ADR 0035).

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `GET /board/legacy`

**Board Legacy.** The previous board, frozen and unsupported (ADR 0043). Gated exactly as `/board` is. It builds its own links from `location.pathname`, so it works at this address unchanged.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `GET /board/v2`

**Board V2.** Board v2's address while it was being built. Kept so a bookmark or a link from that week still lands, with its query, on `/board`.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `GET /favicon.ico`

**Favicon.** Exempt (browsers request it unauthenticated, including on the login page).

**Auth:** Public: the gate admits a caller with no credential. A credential that is presented and invalid is still refused with 401.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |

- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `POST /api/me/agent/{agent}/credential`

**Reissue Agent Credential.** Issue ANOTHER credential for an agent the caller already has — rotation.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. Write: a token needs the `admin` scope; a session needs the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agent` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

#### `GET /api/me/github`

**Get My Github.** The caller's own link state. Always 200 for a session, so the Settings pane can tell 'off' (`configured: false`) from 'not linked'.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `GET /api/me/github/callback`

**Github Link Callback.** GitHub sends the browser back here. The cookie session identifies WHO is linking; `state` proves this callback answers a flow THIS session started. The code is exchanged server-side; the user's access token is used once to read `/user` and never stored. The stable key is the numeric id.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | query | string or null | no |  |  |
| `error` | query | string or null | no |  |  |
| `state` | query | string or null | no |  |  |

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

#### `GET /api/me/github/start`

**Start Github Link.** Begin 'Sign in with GitHub'. A navigation (GET -> 302) that changes no state: it mints a `state` bound to this session and sends the browser to GitHub. The state check at the callback is the CSRF defence.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token.

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)

#### `POST /api/me/github/unlink`

**Unlink My Github.** Remove the caller's own link. If repo access was granted it is revoked on GitHub FIRST and the link stays if that fails - a link removed while the collaborator remains would leave access the owner can no longer see.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. Write: a token needs the `admin` scope; a session needs the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin.

**Request body** (application/json, required): [CsrfOnly](#csrfonly)

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

#### `POST /api/me/password`

**Set My Password.** Set a personal password for an SSO person who has none yet.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. Write: a token needs the `admin` scope; a session needs the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin.

**Request body** (application/json, required): [PasswordSet](#passwordset)

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

### `search`

#### `GET /api/search`

**Search Nodes.** Full-text search across EVERY node — world and workitem alike — via `_search_hits` with no family restriction unless `families` names some. NodeVisibility is applied INSIDE the query exactly as `list_workitems` applies it: `total` is computed AFTER the access filter, so a caller can never infer a hidden node's existence (or a hidden document's) from a filtered page against an unfiltered total.

| `q` | query | string | yes |  |  |

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

## Routes that a setting turns on

These routes do not exist in a default install. Each appears only when its setting is on.

### `ATLAS_CONFIG_WRITES=1`: the configuration panel's write route

#### `config`

##### `PUT /api/config/{name}`

**Config Put.** Change one changeable setting (or reset it with null). Owner session + password only.

**Auth:** Signed in: a session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` token. Write: a token needs the `admin` scope; a session needs the CSRF token from `GET /api/me` and an allowed Origin.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (application/json, required): [ConfigWrite](#configwrite)

**Responses:**

- `200` Successful Response (application/json)
- `422` Validation Error (application/json: [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror))

Sign-in providers configured with `ATLAS_AUTH_PROVIDERS` add `GET /auth/<provider>/start` and `GET /auth/<provider>/callback` for each redirect (OIDC) provider. Both are public.
